crossRefs.note: The sons of Shemer: Ahi, Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.

people.name: Heber
people.line: Son of Beriah, grandson of Asher.

people.name: Japhlet
people.line: Descendant of Asher, son of Heber

translations.web: Heber became the father of Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham, and Shua their sister.
translations.bsb: Heber was the father of Japhlet, Shomer, and Hotham, and of their sister Shua.
translations.kjv: And Heber begat Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.
translations.asv: And Heber begat Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.
